posts.name: dypaca
posts.cooked: Well Akash'Bhuta specifically interacts with the environment by playing an extra card when environment targets enter or leave play.  When she came out, half an environment deck being targets was alot.  Since she came out, we got the promo environments of Silver Gultch and Final Wasteland which are almost entirely targets.  And then there is the Block.  Not only are 10 out of 15 cards targets, but one of the non-targets will summon H-1 environment targets from the deck.

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Ambuscade in the Block was terrifyingly boring.  Especially when the Block shut down damage for a while and we didn't have environment destruction so we just sat there for two turns staring at Ambuscade, it was like that epic tension building scene in Star Wars episode 1 when they stare at each other through a force field.  Epic drama there. (epic)

Megalopolis Chairman has gone really bad for me before.  Having to choose to give up a card play or power each turn is no fun when you are getting swarmed.

One time Ruins of Atlantis played Voss's device that plays the top card when a minion enters play, right before forced deployment put 13 minions into play.  We still won that one, but only because we had G.I. Bunker and some Light speed barrages, having his entire deck in play wasn't cool.  Luckily the gene-bound troops fall apart if their leader is slain so the ruins were safe for democracy.

posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked:
That's Megalopolis, Nielzabub, not Rook City ;). But yeah, Papparazzi, Hostage Situation, and the Traffic Pile-Up are all horrible, and we've had more than one game where those cards basically came out one after the other, every round, so we had a whole load of consecutive rounds where there was something we couldn't do and therefore failed to get properly set up to destroy whichever villain it was we were fighting.

I agree on Matriarch in the Tomb being very horrible - thanks to Akana, we once had every Environment card out at once. Meanwhlie I think Lilian got out most of her stuff, too. Contrast this to when we (deliberately) fought her in the Final Wasteland and had an epic-fun time as all her stuff got totally destroyed (first environment card - Horrid Skunk Ape, second - Unforgiving Wasteland...lol, just lol) except for one lonely Carrion Field. She's horrible in Atlantis too, though - bloody Mystical Defences, arrgh :P. And the Atlantean Font of Power too, actually...and Pillars of Hercules, what with all the extra card play she gets from those. Booo :P.

An environment letting Voss play a card and him bringing out Forced Deployment tends to go very badly as well, seeing as there's nothing we can do to try and eliminate the resultant Minion swarm before they start ganking us :P.

Really, anyone in Rook City is bad because...well, it's Rook City. That said, the best hero to fight there is probably Iron Legacy, just because battles against him tend to be so short that the environment doesn't really get a chance to do anything ;). Environments with mass-AE damage can be nasty if you're fighting the Dreamer, just because of your having to take her damage too so that she doesn't die horribly (volcano, anyone?).

posts.name: byc
posts.cooked:
The Chairman in Rook City is really bad.  The Chairman isn't hindered by anything there except the doctor and Tony.  Falling Statuery sometimes helps by falling on a fence or a thief.

Any villain with lots of targets that deal damage on Wagner Moon Base.  Villainous Weaponary swings games at the wrong times far too often.

Ruins of Atlantis is a difficult environment since there are so many effects that helps villains, and random krakens can be very difficult to handle.  I hate the Leaky Room.

Time Cataclysm can be bad because of multiple environment plays or actually lost in time.

Although the Block has lots of targets, and many of them attack heroes, I think it's actually a pretty good "neutral" environment that can be controlled.

even if the environment played a forced deployment, Voss's Win condition check comes before forced deployment activates…so you always have a chance to cull the minions (or in the case of GI bunker, cut through Voss's armor and try and take him out).  Seems like it played out fine!

Ruins of Atlantis is a difficult environment since there are so many effects that helps villains, and random krakens can be very difficult to handle.

Ruins is the most gonzo environment, and probably my personal favorite for that very reason (Realm of Discord is the other main candidate for that, maybe Pike Industrial for third place).  Getting extra card plays off Pillars or Fount is awesome, even if the villain gets them first.  I'll have to try Miss Information there sometime, just so she'll get her four Clues out fast and we'll be past the annoying "why are we fighting, there aren't any targets?" phase of the battle.

I've played in Rook City twice, and it wasn't especially scary either time.  But I dread Megalopolis because of all the annoying "skip a third of your turn" cards.  I'm just waiting to see all three of them come out at once, so the heroes can literally do nothing for a whole round.  Time Cataclysm is the other one I hate, just because of how random all the effects are.  And to be on topic for the thread, La Capitan in that one was particularly awful.
